throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fcopysign.s $f0, $f8, $f8; fcopysign.s $f1, $f9, $f9; fcopysign.s $f2, $f10, $f10; fcopysign.s $f3, $f11, $f11; fcopysign.s $f4, $f12, $f12; fcopysign.s $f5, $f13, $f13; fcopysign.s $f6, $f14, $f14; fcopysign.s $f7, $f15, $f15

throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4' --asm 'fcopysign.s $f0, $f8, $f8; fcopysign.s $f1, $f9, $f9; fcopysign.s $f2, $f10, $f10; fcopysign.s $f3, $f11, $f11; fcopysign.s $f4, $f12, $f12; fcopysign.s $f5, $f13, $f13; fcopysign.s $f6, $f14, $f14; fcopysign.s $f7, $f15, $f15'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
